title: StockSmart Replenishment Billing in the Stock-Rotation Purchase Base
content:
Replenishment that the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bills for a delivery location also builds the stock-rotation purchase base of that location's Ship-To Fulfillment Account, by the status of the program.

**Clause.** StockSmart replenishment, the extended amount of the replenishment-billed lines dated within the 12 months before the request date of the StockSmart program serving the ship-to, is added to the rotation purchase base in full where that program's status is active, at 50 percent where its status is paused or terminating, and not at all where the ship-to has no program in one of those statuses.

### Records read

- The program is the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program whose ship-to is this delivery location, with its status (enrolled, active, paused, terminating or closed).
- Its billed replenishment is the extended amount of that program's activity lines recorded as replenishment billed, each dated within the 12 months before the request date (fewer than 12 whole months between its date and the request date; whole months being the difference in calendar months, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller).

### Status and amount added

| Program serving the ship-to | Added to the rotation purchase base |
|---|---|
| status active | its billed replenishment of the 12 months, in full |
| status paused or terminating | 50 percent of its billed replenishment of the 12 months |
| enrolled or closed only, or no program | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- An active program with 3000.00 of replenishment billed in the window adds 3000.00.
- The same program while paused adds 1500.00.
- A ship-to whose only program is closed adds nothing.
